integrity: Exact analytic block-mean reduction and monotonicity proof; the numerical checker is corroboration, not a proof of infinite-dimensional asymptotics or originality.
scientific_limitations: Equal-measure two blocks, positive symmetric weights, alpha=0, zero external bias, deterministic L2 flow; only local exponential stability away from the nonhyperbolic threshold. No all-equilibria, global-basin, stochastic-network, or finite-size classification.
title: A sharp high-attention polarization threshold on a strictly positive two-community graphon
